The Model Powerhouse: GLM-5 & MiniMax M2.5

​This version is built around the shift from "vibe coding" to "Agentic Engineering."

​GLM-5 Integration: This 744B parameter beast (from https://t.co/mY7DrYQzvH) is now fully supported. It’s designed for complex systems engineering and long-horizon tasks, narrowing the gap with Claude 4.5. It can now turn raw PRDs directly into formatted .docx or .pdf files end-to-end.

​MiniMax M2.5: Optimized for task decomposition. When paired with OpenClaw’s "Droid" agent, it has reportedly dethroned previous leaders on the SanityBoard for open-weight model performance.

As a loyal OpenClaw user, I love how it powers my daily writing & coding workflows. But two pain points kept bugging me: 💸 excessive token costs and 🤖 model selection that doesn't really get my preferences. So we built something about it — 16+ LLM routers, fully open-sourced! Some are cost-aware to help you save money, while others are personalized routers that learn from your OpenClaw interaction history to adapt model selection to YOU — the more you use it, the better it knows you. Check it out & let us know what you think!
